native.caption: Ты тоже говоришь “I make my homework after dinner”? 😅 По-русски «делаю уроки» — слово «делать» одно, поэтому хочется “make”, а нужно “do.” Правильно: “I do my homework after dinner.” Послушай Карлоса и повтори! Больше практики — в приложении Lexkite.

en.tip: With homework, use “do”: “I do my homework after dinner.”
en.caption: Do you also say “I make my homework after dinner”? 😅 Russian has one word for both, so “make” feels right, but with homework you need “do.” Correct: “I do my homework after dinner.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
